images.name: virtio-win
images.notes: Paravirtualised Windows guest drivers. digest_provenance is local_tofu on purpose: Fedora publishes no digest for this ISO (the CHECKSUM file beside it covers only the four RPMs, in MD5), so any pin here authenticates continuity from one local fetch, NOT origin. PLACEHOLDER DIGEST — record the digest of the specific local fetch that is adopted. kind=iso, so this is NOT usable as a qcow2 backing file.
